content: Soo nanesootuhi pabe'e yise meeoo oo tubenga, “Mu numu haa'a togesapa u-kwitu waha?”

Soo Stephen oo nanekwegease no'oko mu numu meeoo netamma, “E nanumu, e nakapunne. Yaa nanesootuhi nobe-kwi'yoona suu'mu numu nanesootuha'e mee mu unnepana soo Te Naa namooatupu Abraham puu oona kwinga'a mu wakwawa'a tubewa-wi oo manepunne sapa Te Naa-matoo mesoo nanesootuhi, ka Mesopotamia mee naneadu-kwi'yoona. O'nosoo Te Naa ka Abraham natzapoonnekuse,
meeoo oo netamma, ‘U sakwa u nobe no'oko u nanumu ma'wukase, kumma'akoosoo teepu-kooba mea. Nu u pukwi'yookwunu u tzapoonnekukwu.’

Abraham yise oo tumayohoku. Ka tu naa-no mea ka teepu Chaldea mee naneadu-kwi'yoona mease yise Haran mee naneadu-kwi petuga. Oona'yoona soo Abraham naa ya'e. Soo Te Naa yise ka Abraham ekow teepu, eka tamme meno'o pukwi'yoo-koobatoo oo taya.
Gisoo soo Te Naa oo teepu maka Abraham yise punno'o gisoo dooamu-ga'yoo. Gisoo soo Te Naa ka teepu-matu oo nemawunikute.”
Soo Te Naa meeoo tuwazoo oo netamma, “Umu mu doodooamu saa'a wakwawa'a-naga nobe-gadooa. Mu wakwawa'a suda mu matugukwu, unu mu nedya'wena ewasoo tomoba-witoo (400) 'yoo yise namanekwu.
O'no saa'a yise mu wakwawa'a tuma'emukwana umu-matoosoo kodyudooa. O'no mu u-ma'yoona tseagekwudu saa'a yaa nu-baasoo nanesootuhi petudooa.”

Soo Te Naa mu tumayoho tuungu, “Mu sakwa mu naatse doodooamu kootze na'oonnakwitu tsekea'a. O'no umu Te Naa dooamuna nasopedakwatookwu.” Abraham nodukwa naatse dooa'adoo, Isaac mee yise naneahoo. Sumu nasatese soo Abraham yise ka tu tooa tookoo tsekea'a. Ka saa'a yise soo Isaac ka tu tooa Jacob ooosoo yugwe. Soo Jacob yise punno'o umu tu sumumano wahamatsebooeku (12) tu nana'atse ooosoo yugwe.

Soo Te Naa unnena togesapa manepu, mu Jacob doodooamu yise ka tu wannga'a Joseph mee naneadu unu nuusoogweda. Ooonne'yoona umu yise Joseph gi petzape. Umu oo papabe'e ka Joseph-ma tumu. Mu wakwawa'a ka Joseph tumuse ka Egypt-witoo oo bika. Ka oonow petugase, umu oo-ma tumu. Soo Te Naa ka Joseph sootuhi.

Tooe how suda ka Joseph namatugu sapa Te Naa oo magwetzoi. Soo Egypt-witu numu moohetu Pharaoh mee naneadu ka Joseph sopedakwadoose, besa tusoohanedu mee oo soopedyana ka Joseph no'oko mu numu Egypt-witu moohe tuungu, pumme tummatzidu tuwazoo moohedu.
Ka saa'a ka Egypt teepu nana'ena-kwitu gi bow'mana unu pasana gi hee na'a. Mu tubewa-ga'yoo unu suda manepunne. Mu te nanamooatupu gi nadukadu mayu.
“Ewa'yoo tukapu ka Egypt-wi,” mee soo Jacob tunaka. Mu tu doodooamu taya tukapu mu tumu tuunguna.
Ka penakwa tu doodooamu tukapu tumu tuunguse, Joseph tu pabe'emu tuukwe'e, ‘Nu tubetse Joseph,’ mee yise ka Pharaoh-matoo mu bika.
Soo Joseph yise tu pabe'emu no'oko tu nanumu mu bi tuungu. No'yoona (75) mu Joseph nanumu Egypt-wi petuga. Umu ka saa'a osoo tu'ise punowsoo nahanekese, yow te teepu-wisoo natuoona.
Ka Abraham o'nosoo mu Hamor numu-makoo mu tubewa tumu-kwi umu natuoona ona Shechem mee naneadu-kumaba.
Mu numu ewasoo manemena. Soo Te Naa ka Abraham oo tuukwena pudusoo oo-toogoo namanekoo.
Kumma'yoosoo nana mu numu-kooba katudu manekwu, gi uga ka Joseph heesoobedyadu.
Oosoo nana mu te nanamooatupu tumoo'ookese suda mu yugwe. Mu numu tu oonga'a puuwana ma'wu tuungu. Umu yise tua'e.
O'no soo Moses mee naneadu nadooa'adoo. Besa tabuadu oonga'a. Pahe (3) muha umu nobe-kwisoo oo tzakwatse,
o'no yise puuwana ka oonga'a ma'wu. Soo mu numu-kooba katudu padu oo mayuse, yise oo tooaga.
Ka saa'a yise oosoo Moses no'oko mu Egypt numu manena natunedyooe. Besa hemma how yugwedu. Besa unnedu.
Soo Moses ka nana manese yise pummesoo nanumu-baa nobenega.
Ka o petugase, sumu'yoo Egypt nana ka Jew nana unutse mooedyugwe.
Soo Moses ka Egypt nana tutzagow ka tu nanumu-koobatoo.

Soo Moses yise meeoo soonamme, ‘Umu e nanumu ka natzama'wukwuse oo sopedakwadookwu ka Te Naa nuka pooha-makase.’ Pana umu gi oo soo'oedyukute ka ooka moo'a oo petugase, waha'yoo Jew nanana nanagoehoo. Mu too'e tzadyooikuse, meeoo mu netamma, ‘Mu e nananumu gi muusoo nanagoepana.’
Soo nana unu tu pua'a koosekeowdu ka Moses tomatzakowse, meeoo oo netamma, ‘Numu u nemadunagadu mee u naneyugwe.
Hownne'yoo u? Etze'e u sumuoo nana patsow. Meno'o haa'a yise u nuka batsakwu?’
Soo Moses oo nakase, soogweda meeow wakwawa'a teepu Midean mee naneadu-koobatoo. Oonow petugase oonatusoo nodukwadoose, waahoo nana'atse dooamudoo.
Wa'etse manekese soo Moses oona giba Sinai mee naneadu-kumaba'yoona, oonatu nipunne oo poonnese oetoo meahoo heega mee soonammena. Ka goso-baa oo petugase, Te Naa goso-wi'yoona oo yatooe.

content.text: ‘Nu yow, mu tubetse manumudoopu. Nu-matoo mu nanumu, mu nanamooatupuna Abraham, Isaac-no Jacob nanesootuhiyakwe.’

content: Soo Moses oetu tu poonnekwu-ma suise, kwepegawunu.
Soo Te Naa meeoo oo netamma, ‘U moko tzakwumedow u pooha teepu-kooba 'wunu.
Mu Egypt numu e dooamu suda matugu nu mu poonne. Mu e dooamu nanepagamo'o. Nu mu magwetzoidooa. Nu ume Egypt-witoo tayakwu. Umu saa'a mu tzama'wudooa.’

Mooasoo soo Moses te nanamooatupu tumoodyina. Mooasoo umu meeoo oo netamma, ‘Numu u nemadunaga, mee'e u nane'yugwe. Hownne'yoo u?’ Ekow Moses Te Naa umu-matoo tayakwu. Oosoo mu nemadunagana mu moohedooa ka nidu-kwitu pumme tu pooha-makapu-ma. Oosoo nanasookwugi hemma mu tzapoonnekute ka Egypt-wi'yoona. Yise oona Atsa Baa mee naneadu-kumaba'yoona tuwazoo oosoo watsumano (40) tomoka tu nanumu mooheno'o ka oona gi etzaka tukapu namasua-kwi.
Oosoo tu nanumu Te Pabe'e-witu tuukwe, “Sumu'yoo te nanumu-matoo petukwu. Nu ka Te Naa tuukwewabe-matu, oosoo punno'o ooonne'yookwusoo,” mee soo Moses tu nanumu netamma.

Soo Moses tu nanumu-no petu ka giba-kumaba. Oo nobetu-ga ka giba-kumaba, soo Te Naa tummatziwabe soo toha kasa-ga'yoo saa'a oo yadooedooa ka giba-kooba'yoona. Soo Moses saa'a ka giba-ma'yoona wuekese tu nanumu Te Naa pooha unnena tuukwedooa.
Mu te nanumu gi oo nakabetse'a umu ka Egypt numu tumayohonasoo petzabena.

Ka Moses ka giba-matoo kodyukasesoo, umu ka oo pabe'e meeoo netamma, “Numme gi ka Moses unnena mayoho-wa'ne'yoo. Soo Moses ka Egypt-nakwana ne bi petu. Pana meno'o hanoga mea. U sakwa pummatoo te nanesootuhikwuna matabuega.”
Umu yise kootsoo tooa'a-wa'ne tumadabuese, oo-matoo nanesootuha'e. Ewa nanuka ka oo mu tumadabue-matoo. Umu gi Te Naa-matoo nanesootuha'e.
Soo Te Naa yise meeoo mu netamma, ‘Muusoo too'e, ka taba noko paatoosooba-matoo mu nanesootuhi.’ Soo Te Naa tuukwewabe mee umu-witu tubotugu.

content.text: ‘Soo Te Naa mu Jew numu meeoo netamma, “Ewa (40) tomoka mu ka mana gi hemma naa-kwi'yoona, gi nu-matoo nanesootuhina. Mu nu-matoo nanesootuhi mee naneyugwe pana mu nanesootuhi nobe tsekatukuse ka taba-matoo nanesootuhi.
Paatoosooba-matoo tuwazoo. Ooonne'yoona nu mu wakwawa'a numu oona kwinga'a Babylon mee naneadu teepu-koobatoo numu-matoo mu tzama'wukwu.” ’

content: Soo Te Naa yise ka Moses nanesootuhi nobe-too tuungu tooe hemma tooe puhu-makoo. Soo Moses yise oo tumayohoku ooka tu poonne tabua-kwa'ne. Ka tooe hano tooe mu numu momona ka nobe tzanomo'o.

Ka Moses kadoo'oo manese, sumu'yoo nana Joshua mee naneadu ka Moses kapi manekwu. Mu numu ekow teepu-koobatoo ka nobe hanekekoo. Ka mu numu yow petuse, ewa'yoo wakwawa'a mooasoo yow nonobe-ga'yoo. Soo Te Naa mu wakwawa'a kadoo mayugwese umu yise otuoo mu teepu-wi nobe-dookwu. O'no yise soo nanesootuhi nobe ooosapa ka yow teepu-kooba'yookwu. Saa'a soo David nadooa'adoose, nana manepetuga.
Soo Te Naa oo sootuhipu. ‘O'no sakwa nu Te Naa tupe nobe-dookuse,’ mee soo David tusooyugwe.
Gi ooosapa oo tumadabue. Oo tooa Solomon mee naneadu oo nanesootuhi nobe-dooku.
Soo Tamme Manumudoopu gi numu tumadabuena nobe soogwa'e. O'nosoo soo Te Naa yadooawabe meeoo tubotugu,

content.text: ‘Soo Te Naa mee unakwe, “Nu pa'a mu-kooba katu, pana ka e kuku-ma ka teepu mesoo tamma. Nu no'okosoo hemma matabuepu. Mu gi toge nuga pukwi'yoo-wa'nekoo nobe matabue-wa'ne'yoo.” ’ ”

content: Soo Stephen mee tuwazoo unakwe, “Mu yaatoo gi tunaka'oedyukuna gi tumayohodu. Mu nono'otsa Te Naa Besa Pooha netumoo'oo.
Mu nanamooatupu ka Te Naa gi petzabedu. Mu yise punno'o ooosoo manakwe. Mu nanamooatupu ka Te Naa tuukwewabe no'oko suda matugupu-ga'yoo. Umu ka Te Pabe'e petukwuna wahadu yise nagoe.
Te Naa tu tummatziwabe, ka toha kasa-gakoo mu-matoo taya tu unnena mu mayoho tuunguna, pana mu gi oo tumayohokute ka Te Pabe'e batsase.”
Mu numu oo nakasutakute ka Stephen unnena gi nakabetsabena.
Te Naa Besa Pooha tuusoobedyana, toogoopatu poonnese, ka Te Naa poonne. Soo Te Pabe'e ka Te Naa-kumaba 'wunu.
Soo Stephen yise mu numu meeoo tuukwe, “Nu ka toogoopatu Te Pabe'e ka Te Naa-kumaba 'wunu oo pooha poonne.”
No'yoona mu numu tu naka-wi matugumo ka gi oo unnena soonakana, oo nesagwikuna.

Ka Jerusalem-wikoo oo tzadoodooekase oonow petugase, mu oe oo neyugwedu tu wunagapu tzakwumetase, ka sumuoo nana, Saul mee naneadu-kobena mu tuoona petuga. Umu yise tupe-ma ka Stephen tatapageta. Umu oo batsa soogwina.
Gisoo pummetu batsa soo Stephen mee nanesootuhi, “Ne Pabe'e Jesus, besa-kwitoo ka e moogooa hanega.”
Measedose tuwazoo pabatse'e nanesootuhi, “Ka suda mu tumadugu-kwitu gi mu sootu'adyipana.” Oobenakwatoo soo Stephen ya'ehoo gi oo unnena soonakana, oo nesagwa'ekuna.
